notes: The article on the rectum takes the fronted *The*, the ASV rendering *of fools* anarthrously (rule 29, לֻחֹת הָאֲבָנִים shape).
The object suffix is expanded to *every one of them*, headed on the pronoun that directly realizes it (rule 18).
*how* is `added`: the לְ already holds the written *to* and is not a home for a second function word (rules 30, 52).
